reviews.one_line_contribution: It measures the converse marginal that internalization papers skip — the value of trained weights *given* that the same experience pool is back in the prompt — and claims it is ~zero on ALFWorld (so a hybrid never beats the untrained in-context ceiling and the residual value of context is exactly the un-retained part of the in-context gain, type by type), then spends that claim on a retention-routed injection policy costed against single-substrate arms on one GPU-hour axis.
reviews.closest_prior_work: UCOB (arXiv:2606.29502, VERIFIED on S2, 2026-06-28, 8 citations): credit-aware on-policy bidirectional self-distillation between skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts, evaluated on ALFWorld and WebShop, reporting up to +23.5 points on ALFWorld over 'skill-free RL, skill-memory baselines, and self-distillation methods'. A 'skill-memory baseline' is an untrained agent with the experience in context, so UCOB's headline contrast *is* the proposal's WV estimand (trained-with-context minus untrained-with-context), already measured on the same environment and already large and positive. That does two kinds of damage: it weakens the claim that nobody measures this marginal, and it supplies a published counterexample to P2. The proposal's Related Work cites UCOB only in the appendix-B discussion of a previous round's idea and never confronts its number. For the routing half the closest is COVE (arXiv:2608.01234, VERIFIED, 2026-08-02): 'Learning What to Remember and What to Internalize in LLM Self-Evolution via Adaptive Memory-Parameter Coordination' — task-aware routing between the harness/memory channel and the parameter channel, reported to beat single-channel evolution. The proposal's differentiator over COVE and Skill0.5 (arXiv:2605.28424, VERIFIED) is real but thin: cost accounting and matched single-substrate arms, not the routing idea itself.
reviews.strongest_objection: P1 is not an independent prediction; it is an algebraic identity applied to P2, and its estimator is biased toward the predicted value by shared noise. By the proposal's own definitions, RV = student_matched - student_k0, (1-r)g = g - (student_k0 - untrained_k0) = untrained_matched - student_k0, so RV - (1-r)g = student_matched - untrained_matched = WV, exactly. The 'substitution slope across ~40 type-by-arm cells' is therefore the per-cell WV=0 statement re-plotted in different coordinates, not corroborating evidence, and it falls under the brief's own 'no prediction entailed by a definition' rule. Worse, x and y share the term -student_k0, so sampling noise in the student's memory-free accuracy moves both coordinates in the same direction and drags the OLS slope toward +1 — the headline estimator is biased toward confirming the hypothesis, and per-type cells carry +/-13-15 net-point CIs, so most of the fitted variance is that shared noise. What remains is P2, an equivalence test at a +/-5-point margin run with a pooled CI half-width of +/-4.6 points, on a split whose in-context ceiling is 0.807/0.869 — i.e. a failure-to-reject at the resolution limit, on a compressed scale, which is precisely the binding objection that killed harm_does_not_distill in appendix B ('the equivalence margin exceeded the effect being probed'). A genuinely additive +4 points (SESA-scale additivity, arXiv:2607.29468, VERIFIED, which reports +0.5-1.0 residual) is indistinguishable from substitution under this design, and 'substitution' would be declared.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: (1) Drop the ~40-cell slope regression as a headline or re-derive it honestly: report WV per cell directly with its CI, and if a slope is wanted, fit it with an errors-in-variables estimator that uses independent seed splits for the student_k0 term entering x and y (e.g. split-half seeds), so the shared-noise bias toward slope 1 is removed. (2) Make P2 a powered test rather than a TOST at the noise floor: pre-register the margin as a fraction of the Gate-0 hybrid gain as the brief demands (5 points is ~18% of +27, but it is also the CI half-width), and buy the seeds needed to get the pooled CI to ~+/-2, or move the confirmatory contrast to the three multi-step types where g is +39 to +55 and the ceiling is not binding. (3) Add one strong internalization arm (on-policy self-distillation / UCOB-style credit-aware self-distillation, which the brief lists as an in-scope reimplementation) — otherwise WV~0 is a statement about weak QLoRA-SFT students, not about substrates, and UCOB's published +23.5 on ALFWorld stands as an unaddressed refutation. (4) Lead with P3 and P4, the two predictions that are not definitional: the manufactured held-out-type contrast and the retention-vs-random-vs-decoy router comparison are the paper's actual content.
reviews.missing_baseline: A zero-training, gain-routed context policy on the untrained agent: inject k=3 only for the task types where the untrained in-context gain g_t is large (Step 0 already localizes these — the three multi-step types at +39 to +55, with look-at-object at -4.8), and k=0 elsewhere. This costs no GPU-hours, needs no calibration split beyond Gate 0, and sits at the same injection fraction as the retention router. Under the proposal's own substitution hypothesis (WV~0) the trained student with context is indistinguishable from the untrained agent with context, so this baseline should match the retention router on accuracy at zero training cost and dominate it on the Pareto plot everywhere left of the break-even. Relatedly, the plan never confronts its own Step 0 numbers on k: untrained k=1 already recovers 75% (valid_seen) and 71% (valid_unseen) of the k=3 gain at ~140 vs ~430 injected tokens, which by itself satisfies P4's pre-registered success criterion ('within 25% of the full hybrid's gain at f<=0.5'). The all-context k=1 arm is in the plan but its implication — that the router's target is met by simply lowering k — is not addressed anywhere in the predictions or the cost section.
reviews.preprint_collision: No verified collision found; the proposal's own check is above average for this round but has two identifiable holes. Queries I ran, all via the literature command (s2cli, channels reported s2=ok hf=ok; WebSearch not used, quota exhausted; WebFetch never used): (Q1, --recent) 'marginal value of trained weights when retrieved memory is put back in context after internalization' -> 8 hits, nearest 2608.12218 (Information Abundance Paradox), 2607.10608, 2605.08374, rest off-topic; nothing measuring the converse marginal. (Q2, --recent) 'does retrieved experience still help after distillation into weights substitution additivity agent memory' -> 11 hits incl. 2607.21051 (Experience Distillation), 2607.28272 (MemHarness), 2604.27003, 2605.12978; none runs the trained-student-with-memory vs untrained-with-memory contrast. (Q3, --recent) 'route memory to context or weights per task type retention-aware hybrid token cost agent' -> 11 hits, most relevant 2608.15008 (substrate benchmark, VERIFIED), 2602.06025 (BudgetMem, query-aware budget-tier memory routing), 2607.13591 (MemCon, learned memory injection that reduces token use); these anticipate cost-aware memory routing but not retention-based type routing after internalization. (Q4, --recent) 'fine-tuning versus retrieval augmentation combined does retrieval still help after knowledge injection into weights' -> 5 hits, all off-topic (retrieval-model training). (Q5, no --recent) 'parametric and contextual knowledge redundant not additive fine-tuned model no better than base model with context' -> 12 hits, nearest 2606.03657 (NovelAPIBench: retrieval vs fine-tuning for API acquisition, concludes the two are complementary — a QA/tool-use analogue of the additivity side, not agent trajectories), 2503.15888, 2503.05919. (Q6, --recent) 'skill internalization ALFWorld evaluate student with and without skill context 2x2 retained gain per task type' -> 9 hits, incl. 2606.29502 (UCOB), 2608.14036 (Demystifying Agent Skills: skills work by procedural anchoring, relevant to the type-localization story), 2607.26784, 2604.20087. ID verification: I verified on S2/HF 2607.21051, 2607.29468 (SESA, title 'Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution', which does state the bank 'retain[s] value as optional external memory' — the proposal's characterization holds), 2605.28424, 2604.02268, 2606.29502, 2608.15008, 2608.01234, 2512.02543. I could NOT verify 2607.26017 (UniMem): not found on S2 or HF — the proposal leans on it in Related Work for the routing-motivation claim, and appendix B already flags it as unverified, so it should not be carried as a citation. The two holes in the proposal's own check: (a) it lists COVE 2608.01234 in Related Work but never treats it as a collision candidate, although adaptive memory-vs-parameter task-aware routing is the closest published form of its P4 contribution; (b) it never searched outside agent memory for the additivity/substitution question (RAG-vs-fine-tuning knowledge injection), where 2606.03657 reports the complementary finding on a different task family. Neither is a collision, but both should appear in the check rather than in the reviewer's report.
